caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate metal object resembling a hinge or strap with two extended, curved arms. The arms are asymmetrical, each featuring a series of flowing, hooked curves that end in sharp, curled points; one arm curves upward and the other downward. The metal is colored in shades of brown with darker patches, likely indicating rust or surface oxidation. Each arm is punctuated with several small, round holes, possibly for mounting or attachment purposes, and the ends feature small protruding elements. Attached at the left end of the object is a cylindrical sleeve or clamp, giving the piece a T-shaped composition. The background is a plain, light beige color, providing contrast for the central metallic object.
title: Hinge Butt
